answer: Each identity keeps a mirror ledger: every verified job is reflected in a public mirror record signed by its own quill, a one-time signing key bound to its funding source. An ember verifier, an independent identity that burned 40 POA to earn its torch, cross-checks the mirror against the ledger; a mirror that fails burns the author's 60 POA ember deposit and revokes its quill for 8 epochs. A fake needs its own quill, mirror history, and 60 POA ember, so ten clones cost 600 POA in burned ember deposits, and no ember, quill, or mirror can be shared or reused across clones.
